director.tagline_zh: 遊戲廣告 · 商業影像 · 產品片 · 賽事片頭 · 實拍 · CG
director.tagline_en: Game Commercials · Branded Films · Product Films · Esports Opens · Live Action · CG
director.point_of_view_zh: 遊戲廣告、商業影像、產品片與賽事片頭；武俠、奇幻、喜劇，實拍與 CG。
director.point_of_view_en: Game commercials, branded films, product films and esports opens; wuxia, fantasy and comedy in live action and CG.
director.bio_zh: 鄭又勛，台灣導演。作品涵蓋遊戲廣告、商業影像、產品片與賽事片頭，拍過武俠、奇幻、喜劇，也做實拍與 CG。
director.bio_en: York Cheng is a director based in Taiwan. His work spans game commercials, branded films, product films and esports opens, moving through wuxia, fantasy and comedy in live action and CG.

works.copy_zh: 一場圍攻，最後證明的竟是 1250ml 真的夠一桌人喝。對方問「夠嗎」時還在叫陣，主角只補一個「茶」，兩瓶茶上桌，刀劍便全放下了。
works.copy_en: A siege ends up proving that 1,250 ml really is enough for a whole table. “夠嗎?” first sounds like a challenge. The hero adds a single 茶, two bottles land on the table, and every sword comes down.

works.copy_zh: 喬峰和虛竹大半支片都不在場，段譽腰間的三只酒杯先替他們留了位置。權力、愛情和兄弟三段走完，他在雁門關前把酒斟滿，兩個人才短暫回到畫面裡。片名問「何為執念」，答案其實很簡單：什麼都能放下，兄弟放不下。
works.copy_en: Qiao Feng and Xu Zhu are absent for most of the film, but the three cups at Duan Yu’s waist have already saved their places. Power, love and brotherhood pass through his journey. At Yanmen Pass he fills every cup, and the two men return for a moment. He can let go of almost everything—just not his brothers.

works.copy_zh: 黑袍骨冠裡，還是那個一身白衣的人。故人都死了，偏偏留下她一個；怨念從手臂一路爬上來，她說：「散不去，那就和我一起成魔。」徐若瑄坐上白骨王座時，前面那份悲傷沒有消失，只是換成了白骨夫人的樣子。
works.copy_en: Beneath the black robes and crown of bones is the same woman who once stood in white. Everyone she knew is gone, leaving grief to crawl up her arm as she says, “If it will not fade, become a demon with me.” When Vivian Hsu takes the bone throne, the sorrow is still there. It has simply found the shape of the White Bone Demoness.

works.copy_zh: 道長還沒進門，兩盞紅燈籠中間，早已替他留好位置。桃木劍、鬼差、八卦法陣把場面鬧得像一場抓鬼，紅幔一落，整間屋子早就是她備好的喜堂。鬼沒收成，道長反倒被留下，最後成了鬼新娘的紙紮人偶。
works.copy_en: Before the Taoist enters, a place is already waiting for him between two red lanterns. Peachwood swords, ghost guards and a bagua formation make the night look like a noisy exorcism. Then the red drapes fall and reveal the house for what it has been all along: her wedding hall. He fails to take the ghost away. The ghost bride keeps him instead, as her paper effigy.

works.copy_zh: 「我看某」本來還在自嘲，多一個「你」，馬上變成嗆人的「我看你某」。客棧裡，蕭煌奇還穩穩坐著，四周已經打成一團——「我的勢力（視力）你惹不起」。到了變身篇，蒙眼布一綁，偏偏寫著「我看得見」：視力沒回來，武功倒先練成了。
works.copy_en: The joke begins with one extra Chinese character. “我看某” sounds self-deprecating; add 你 and “我看你某” becomes a sharp comeback. Xiao Huang-chi remains calmly seated while the inn erupts around him—“我的勢力（視力）你惹不起” lets power and eyesight share the same sound. In the transformation film, a blindfold declares “我看得見”: his sight has not returned, but his martial arts have arrived first.

works.title_en: ROU CI FANG — The Way of Meat
works.copy_zh: 對大部分消費者來說，不過是切個肉，怎麼了嗎？但對肉次方來說，是一門需要時間、精神，才能達到完美的大學問。也許大家都會切肉，但就像柔道一樣有段位之差，切肉這門學問也有黑帶級別的存在。切肉之道，肉道黑帶最知道！
works.copy_en: For most people, it is only slicing meat. At ROU CI FANG, it takes time and focus to reach the perfect cut. Anyone can hold a knife, just as anyone can step onto a judo mat—but rank still matters. In the way of meat, there is such a thing as a black belt.

works.copy_zh: 磁浮本身看不見。刀頭貼近皮膚時，畫面在皮膚上建立藍色保護層，刀片懸浮在上面把鬍鬚輕鬆除乾淨；我們想表達的是刮鬍子也能極致舒適。
works.copy_en: Magnetic levitation cannot be seen. As the razor reaches the skin, a blue protective layer appears beneath the suspended blades and the stubble comes away cleanly. The point is simple: shaving can feel exceptionally comfortable.

works.title_zh: Google Play 台灣《就差一點》
works.copy_zh: 「就差一點」是玩家常有的那口不甘心，也剛好藏著 Google Play Points 的那一點。片子把精煉失敗放在前面，Points 出現後，再回到精煉成功。這支廣告想說的很簡單：玩家差的那一點，Google Play 多給一點。
works.copy_en: “就差一點” captures the frustration of falling just short, while 點 also means a point in Google Play Points. The film opens on a failed upgrade. Points arrive, the attempt is repeated, and this time it succeeds. When the player is missing that last little bit, Google Play adds a little more.

works.copy_zh: 一整場戰爭，其實都藏在藩主和自己下的那盤棋裡。棋子落下，煙裡起兵；兜帽掀開是同一張臉，也替「人生最大的對手，正是自己」撐起了整場戲。
works.copy_en: An entire war is hidden inside a lord’s match against himself. One piece lands and armies rise from the smoke. When the hood comes off, the same face is waiting across the board—the film has already shown why his greatest opponent can only be himself.

works.title_en: Soul Land: World of Soul Hunters
works.copy_zh: 《終極一班》的四個人回到熟悉的樓梯、教室和沙發，校園卻已經開始出現另一套規則。雷婷的帶電戰鎚直接亮在走廊裡，其他人的武魂也各自在原本的空間現身；等到「終極再集結」落下，他們才一起走進《斗羅大陸》的山水與巨獸之間。
works.copy_en: The four familiar faces from KO One return to the stairs, classroom and sofa, except the school now follows another set of rules. A charged war hammer appears in the corridor, and each martial soul enters the space its character once occupied. By the time “The Ultimate Reunion” lands, the group is ready to step from campus into Soul Land’s mountains and beasts.

works.copy_zh: 姊妹替彼此撐住的關係，從童年一路長進仙俠世界。童年的畫在月夜水面成了星蘊源鯤，任家萱和任容萱隔著古今相望，「做你的靠山」因此有了具體形狀。
works.copy_en: Two sisters have held each other up since childhood, and that bond grows with them into the xianxia world. A childhood drawing rises from the moonlit water as Xingyun Yuankun; Selina Jen and Lorene Jen face one another across past and present. “I’ll be the one behind you” finally has a visible form.

works.copy_zh: 女戰士背著陽光走進紅燭法陣，體內那股力量開始吞噬靈魂，惡魔也跟著覺醒。職業卡到這時才亮起「半魔人」，「選擇你的命運吧」也有了重量：玩家要選的，正是剛剛看她一步步走到的命運。
works.copy_en: A warrior enters the red-candle formation with sunlight at her back. The force inside her begins to consume her soul, and the demon wakes with it. Only then does the class card reveal “Demonic.” “Choose your fate” now carries the weight of everything that led her there—the player is choosing the fate just witnessed.

works.copy_zh: 林心如穿著黑禮服走進赤壁火場，紅甲的火鳳孫尚香伸手點上她額頭。金符亮起，她掌心生出藍紫能量，英雄卡也從火裡翻開。前世把力量交給今生，今生抬手時，遊戲裡的英雄卡也跟著出現。
works.copy_en: Ruby Lin walks into the fires of Red Cliff in a black gown. The red-armoured Fire Phoenix Sun Shangxiang touches her forehead; a golden sigil flashes, blue-violet energy gathers in her palm, and a hero card opens in the flames. Power passes from a former life into the present, and the in-game hero arrives with it.

works.copy_zh: 桃花看起來像被追殺的弱女子，劍一出鞘，她自己殺出重圍；凌煙像是等人保護，扇子一開，先出手的也是她。兩支單人篇各騙觀眾一次，雙人篇再讓一劍一扇回到同一場中秋夜宴。這組紅顏最好看的地方，是每個人都跟第一眼不一樣。
works.copy_en: Taohua first looks like a woman waiting to be rescued. Once her sword clears the sheath, she fights her own way out. Lingyan seems to need protection too, until her fan opens and she strikes first. Each solo film misleads the audience once; the third brings sword and fan together at the same Mid-Autumn banquet. Neither woman is quite who she appeared to be at first glance.

works.copy_zh: 林志穎問「心中的光是什麼」，守候、初見與一起扛雷劫便成了出劍的理由。金色劍氣劈開冷戰場、暖色仙山亮起時，這一劍帶著的是前面三段關係。
works.copy_en: Jimmy Lin asks, “What is the light in your heart?” Waiting, first encounters and weathering a heavenly trial together become the reasons to draw a sword. When golden sword light cuts through the cold battlefield and the warm immortal mountains appear, the three relationships travel with that single strike.

works.copy_zh: 一支把「五星九選一」和「100 抽」做成兩顆紅按鈕，既然都送，就不用選。另一支直接致敬《美國隊長》的電梯大戰迷因：滿屋西裝男一臉正經，字幕卻聊著普發六千和怒課百抽；等「這些魔靈召喚都用送的」落下，現場真的打成一團。
works.copy_en: One film presents “choose one of nine five-stars” and “100 summons” as two red buttons. Both rewards are free, so there is no reason to choose—press both. The other borrows the Captain America elevator-fight meme: a room of suited men stays completely serious while the captions discuss the NT$6,000 payout and spending it on a hundred summons. “Summoners War gives all of this away” lands, and the elevator finally erupts.

works.copy_zh: 一家四口原本各忙各的。恐龍先把臉貼上落地窗，下一次已經站上山路；少年舉起手機，全家就在客廳變成四名冒險者，最後一起走進遊戲森林。烏拉拉的世界沒有等他們準備好，直接闖進家門。
works.copy_en: A family of four begins in separate corners of the house. A dinosaur presses its face against the window and soon appears on the mountain road. The son raises his phone; the family reappears in the living room as a four-person party, then walks together into the game forest. Ulala does not wait for them to get ready. Its world comes straight through the front door.

works.title_zh: 魔鏡物語魔紅帽＋魔白雪
works.title_en: Tales of Mirror — Dark Red Hood & Dark Snow White
works.copy_zh: 「從前從前」說得愈像真的，後面那一下才愈狠。小紅帽沿著血跡進屋，最後捧出狼頭，還說要拿來治奶奶；白雪沉睡後，巫婆問的也不再是誰最美，而是誰最強大，持刀的白雪正站在答案裡。
works.copy_en: The more sincerely “once upon a time” is told, the harder the next image hits. Red Hood follows a blood trail and emerges holding the wolf’s head, saying it will cure her grandmother. After Snow White wakes, the witch no longer asks who is fairest, but who is strongest. Snow White is already standing there with the knife.

works.copy_zh: 「我要」從一個、兩個一路加到五個、七個，徐錦江的貪心也跟著佔滿整個畫面。每開一扇門，人物更多、房間更大；到了「我全都要」，原本的構圖早已裝不下他的胃口。
works.copy_en: “I want” grows from one to two, then five, then seven, until Elvis Tsui’s appetite fills the frame. Every opened door brings more people and a larger room. By “I want them all,” the original composition can no longer contain what he wants.

works.copy_zh: 他把最後一點力氣，全用來送她離開。女主御劍穿出夜林，他自己留在追兵之中；前一世沒能一起走，千年後，兩個人才在街頭重新遇見。
works.copy_en: He spends the last of his strength sending her away. She rides the sword out of the night forest while he stays behind among the pursuers. They could not leave together in their first life. A thousand years later, they finally meet again on a city street.

works.title_zh: ASUS ZenBook Pro Duo × 王宗欣《映照美力》
works.title_en: ASUS ZenBook Pro Duo × Wang Tsung-Hsin — Beauty in Reflection
works.copy_zh: 手指落上 ScreenPad Plus，主螢幕裡的形體隨著操作移動；鏡頭再從桌上的雙螢幕走進氣球、光管和整條投影長廊。ZenBook Pro Duo 沒有離開作品現場，產品與《映照美力》從頭到尾都在同一個創作空間裡。
works.copy_en: A finger reaches the ScreenPad Plus and the forms on the main display respond. The camera then travels from the two screens on the desk into balloons, light tubes and a full projection corridor. The ZenBook Pro Duo never leaves the artwork behind; product and exhibition occupy the same creative space from beginning to end.

works.copy_zh: GODIVA 的聖誕禮盒在桌上出現之前，深藍與金色已經掛到台北天際線上。巧克力與配料在 101 前疊成深藍吊飾，球面浮起 GODIVA 字樣，限定系列因而有了城市奇觀的份量。
works.copy_en: Before the gift box reaches the table, deep blue and gold are already hanging over Taipei’s skyline. Chocolates and ingredients stack into an ornament in front of Taipei 101; GODIVA rises across its surface. The limited collection arrives with the scale of a city spectacle.

works.title_zh: Schick 舒適牌《舒芙晶透煥亮 CC 刀》
works.copy_zh: 除毛刀刮得乾不乾淨，一眼就看得出來；潤膚和煥亮沒那麼容易。檸檬接到維他命 C，刀頭遇水起泡，再依序帶到腿、手臂和腋下的使用示範。除毛、潤膚、煥亮，就在同一個動作裡一起發生。
works.copy_en: A close shave is easy to see. Moisture and radiance need more help. Lemon leads to vitamin C, the razor head foams when wet, and the demonstrations move through legs, arms and underarms. Hair removal, moisture and radiance happen within the same pass.

works.title_zh: 《傳說對決》2018 GCS 夏季賽片頭
works.copy_zh: One、Beicun、BVEL、HAK……八支隊伍各派一位選手，先從剪影、火光和霓虹門框裡走出來。等八張身分卡亮完，個人、小隊、多隊才一起回到同一座舞台。2018 夏季賽，就從這群真正要上場的人開始。
works.copy_en: One, Beicun, BVEL, HAK and the rest of the eight teams each send one player forward. They emerge first through silhouettes, firelight and neon frames. After all eight identity cards have appeared, individuals, squads and the full league share one stage. The summer season begins with the people who are about to play it.

works.title_zh: 《英雄聯盟》2018 LMS 春季賽片頭
works.copy_zh: 春季賽開打前，獎盃本來就不該在任何人手上。八隊選手先分散在火光、煙霧、門洞和廢棄長廊裡，隊服、隊旗和隊徽讓不同隊伍慢慢被認出來。到了後段，獎盃才在中央亮起，多位選手從不同方向靠近；誰能走到它面前，當時還沒有答案。
works.copy_en: Before the spring season begins, the trophy belongs to no one. Players from eight teams stand apart in firelight, smoke, doorways and abandoned corridors; jerseys, flags and crests slowly identify them. Only later does the trophy light up at the centre and draw everyone toward it. At that moment, nobody knows who will reach it.

works.copy_zh: 戰力一億是在種田嗎？末日該帶狗還是帶咖啡？在《星球重啟》裡，這些話原本都像在聊現實，下一秒卻會落到溫室、豪宅、神寵或跨平台實機。六支片各自鬧一場誤會，遊戲總在答案揭開時出現。
works.copy_en: Is one hundred million combat power only for farming? In the apocalypse, should the one thing you bring be a dog or coffee? Each line first sounds like ordinary conversation, then lands on a greenhouse, mansion, companion or cross-platform play. Six films set up six misunderstandings; the game appears with each answer.

works.copy_zh: FreeStyle 的速度，得從田壘和高國豪的身體上接進遊戲。停車場的運球、碰撞與起跳連到 CG 灌籃，手機畫面展開成 3v3 UI，球的重量一路沒有斷。
works.copy_en: FreeStyle’s speed has to reach the game through the bodies of Tien Lei and Benson Kao. Dribbles, contact and takeoffs in the parking garage carry into a CG dunk; the phone then opens onto the 3v3 interface. The weight of the ball stays intact across every layer.

works.title_en: 熱血江湖：歸來 — Two Campaigns
works.copy_zh:
六月篇——五位啦啦隊員站在黃色置物櫃前，櫃門一開，戰袍和兵器跟著出現。進到紅棚，她們分別成為弓手、刀客、醫師、劍客與槍客；「我們的舞台不是球場」落下時，五種職業已經站成同一隊。

新刺客篇——盜匪為天下至寶聚在夜林，刺客早就藏在他們看不見的地方。雙刀一亮，真人近身交手與血月、面具、飛刀的角色畫面交錯；最後「邪派刺客」四個字出現，再接「十月十日，新職業『刺客』復仇歸來」，新角色的身分和上線時間一起揭開。
works.copy_en:
June — Five Classes:

Five cheerleaders stand before yellow lockers. Each open door reveals a costume and weapon. In the red studio they appear as archer, bladesman, healer, swordswoman and spearfighter. By “Our stage is not the ballpark,” all five classes have formed one party.

October — New Assassin:

Bandits gather in a night forest for the world’s greatest treasure; the assassin is already hiding beyond their sight. Twin blades flash between live close combat and images of a blood moon, mask and flying knives. “Dark-Faction Assassin” names the role, followed by the October 10 return date—the new class and its arrival are revealed together.

works.copy_zh: 職場篇裡，瑋哥整理好領帶才敢進門；校園篇換成制服，他還是一樣緊張，主動權從頭到尾都在琳妲手上。桌面、絲襪、貼地視角把曖昧推到最滿，他問：「這畫面是不用解鎖就可以看的嗎？」手機一亮，螢幕裡其實是一張 SSR 角色卡，「不用解鎖」也從成人暗示變成了遊戲笑話。
works.copy_en: At the office, Wei straightens his tie before he dares to enter. Back in a school uniform, he is just as nervous; Linda holds the initiative in both films. The desk, stockings and floor-level angles push the tease as far as possible. Then he asks whether this view is free to watch. The phone lights up with an SSR character card, and “unlocking” becomes a game joke.

works.copy_zh: 啦啦隊員、都會 CEO、包租婆，同一位代言人在一首歌裡換了三個身分。她先把辦公室裡的加班狗拉去跳舞，再讓全世界等著 CEO 開會，最後戴著髮捲走到街上收租；每換一個身分，城市看板就把她再放大一次，最後整條街都下起鈔票雨。
works.copy_en: Cheerleader, metropolitan CEO and landlady: the same spokesperson takes on three lives within one song. She pulls an overworked employee into a dance, keeps the world waiting for the CEO’s meeting, then walks into the street in hair rollers to collect rent. Every new role appears larger on the city billboards, until banknotes rain across the whole block.

works.copy_zh:
盟主問「有誰不服」，各個文明輪流回「我不服」；接著一句「不服就打到你服」，大殿立刻開打。打完再接「全球玩家一起打／萬人同服才夠爽」，同一個「服」先是不服氣，再被打服，最後接到伺服器。這支片就拿一個字，把衝突、笑點和遊戲賣點一起串起來。

另一篇則用沙盤兵俑，把「無損徵兵、把把 ALL-IN」演成一場看似要輸光的豪賭。
works.copy_en:
Global War:

The leader asks who refuses to submit, and every civilisation answers “我不服.” “Then we’ll fight until you 服” starts the brawl. The same character 服 moves from defiance, to submission, to 同服—players sharing one server. Conflict, joke and product message all sit inside one word.

Lossless Recruitment:

On a sand table, clay soldiers make “lossless recruitment, every hand ALL-IN” look like a wager that could wipe everything out.
